heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly clear a few passing high clouds northwest. Not as cold. Lows in the 20s to near 30 northeast, in the 30s southeast and around Lake Champlain. Light winds east of the Green Mountains, and south winds from the Green Mountains west 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly sunny, with some high clouds edging into southern areas during the afternoon. Milder. Highs in the 50s to low 60s. Light winds east of the Green Mountains, and south winds from the Green Mountains west 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Mostly clear, except some high clouds in southeast VT into southern NH and MA. Lows in the 30s.
